# NoirMD — Documentation

> NoirMD is a **framework-agnostic markdown renderer**: one vanilla DOM rendering engine with thin React/Vue wrappers. It ships a custom parser, a 16-type directive system (admonitions, cards, modals, details, buttons, slides), rich inline syntax, built-in syntax highlighting (highlight.js) and modular pure CSS theming. This file indexes the official documentation. All links are relative to the site root.

## What is NoirMD?

NoirMD transforms Markdown into a typed AST and renders it with a single vanilla DOM engine (`renderMarkdownString(markdown) → HTMLElement`). React and Vue bindings are thin mount-point wrappers around that engine, so behavior is identical across frameworks.

Pipeline: `parseMarkdown(markdown)` → typed `Token[]` AST → vanilla DOM renderer → `HTMLElement` appended by the framework wrapper.

- **Framework-agnostic**: one engine for React, Vue, vanilla JS or any framework
- **Custom parser**: line-by-line state machine producing a typed `Token[]` AST
- **Directive system**: 16 directive strings mapped to 7 rich components (admonitions, cards, modals, details, buttons, wrappers, slides)
- **Modular CSS**: pure CSS split into `variables.css`, `base.css` and one file per component; `--color-*` host-variable theming
- **Rich inline syntax**: bold, italic, highlight, color, spoiler, underline, icons, centered/right-aligned text and more
- **Syntax highlighting**: code blocks with highlight.js built-in
- **Optional editor**: CodeMirror 6 powered markdown editor with live preview

## Installation

```bash
# Core + React
npm install @noirmd/previewer react react-dom

# Core + Vue 3
npm install @noirmd/previewer vue

# Core only (Vanilla JS)
npm install @noirmd/previewer
```

Optional editor dependencies:

```bash
npm install @uiw/react-codemirror @codemirror/view @codemirror/state @codemirror/language @lezer/highlight
```

## Package Entry Points

| Import path | Description | Dependencies |
|-------------|-------------|--------------|
| `@noirmd/previewer/core` | Parser, types, utilities | None |
| `@noirmd/previewer/vanilla` | Vanilla DOM renderer — the single rendering engine | None (highlight.js bundled) |
| `@noirmd/previewer/react` | Thin React mount-point wrapper | React ≥18 |
| `@noirmd/previewer/vue` | Thin Vue mount-point wrapper | Vue ≥3 |
| `@noirmd/previewer` | Backward-compatible (core + react) | React ≥18 |
| `@noirmd/previewer/editor` | CodeMirror 6 editor | React + CodeMirror |
| `@noirmd/previewer/editor.css` | Self-contained editor styles (toolbar, layout) | — |
| `@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css` | Full CSS entry (`@import`s all partials) | — |

## Configuration

- **CSS is required.** Import `@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css` once at the top level of your app. Without it, content renders but has no visual styling (no heading sizes, no table borders, no code block backgrounds).
- The CSS is modular: `variables.css` (design tokens), `base.css` (global/reusable styles) and one file per component. Importing `vanilla.css` pulls in everything via `@import`.
- **Theming**: CSS custom properties (`--nr-*`) with `--color-*` host-variable fallbacks (`--color-background-primary`, `--color-text-primary`, `--color-accent-primary`, ...).
- **Tailwind**: works alongside NoirMD — its class names don't conflict. The `tailwindCDN` prop is only needed for Tailwind classes authored inside markdown content; `scanTailwindCDN()` must be called after DOM mutations that add new Tailwind classes.
- **SSR caveat**: React/Vue wrappers render on the client only (`useEffect`/`onMounted`) — server render is an empty placeholder.
- **Editor styles**: `@noirmd/previewer/editor.css` is self-contained and uses `var(--color-*, fallback)` so the host theme wins when defined.
- **Gotchas**: unclosed directives (`:::type` without closing `:::`) render as plain text; `<style>` blocks inject globally into `<head>`; directives have their own padding/borders — avoid nesting them inside flex/grid containers; consecutive `card`/`card-m`/`card-b` auto-batch into a flex-wrap row (use `batch="off"` to disable).

## Quick Usage

### React

```tsx
import { NRpreviewer } from '@noirmd/previewer/react';
import '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css';

function App() {
  return <NRpreviewer content="# Hello **world**" tailwindCDN />;
}
```

### Vue 3

```vue
<script setup>
import { NRpreviewer } from '@noirmd/previewer/vue';
import '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css';

const markdown = '# Hello **world**';
</script>

<template>
  <NRpreviewer :content="markdown" />
</template>
```

### Vanilla JS

```ts
import { renderMarkdownString } from '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla';
import '@noirmd/previewer/vanilla/vanilla.css';

const el = renderMarkdownString('# Hello **world**');
document.getElementById('app')!.appendChild(el);
```
